notes: Independent expanded review of the frozen CAP-04.S04.T03 R01 candidate under approved S04 section 9.3, accepted ADR-0027, and experience reference RO-UI-ACADEMIC-MINIMAL-1.7. The exact manifest hash matches the REVIEW backlog projection; all 67 changed paths equal the base-to-candidate Git diff, all 23 cited raw-log hashes reproduce, all cited checks exit zero, and the build report identifies a clean 22e184e5 source. Source review and executed evidence support distinct canonical-item denominators, source/path overlap arithmetic, exact protected drill, explicit missingness, source-specific rights checks, idempotent rollback/restart, and populated-v18-to-v19 migration recovery. The authenticated Windows case proves Core, DPAPI/SQLCipher, restart, and revoked historical-report access. One task-level evidence gap blocks approval: the cited Corpus Canvas desktop tests render static markup and call pure helpers, but do not activate the mounted production controls that must take a user from an aggregate count to an exact record drill and support keyboard/focus and denial/recovery behavior. The real Core test proves the service boundary, not that renderer interaction. S04 section 11 incremental project/source summaries, indexes, and warm/cold representative performance qualification remain distinct open slice obligations; their deferral alone is not this T03 finding. Full affected profiles and independent S04/W2 qualification are likewise later gates. The reviewer made no product, test, backlog, or Git mutation and ran no unchanged full profile.

acceptance_reviews.assessment: Protected repository/model and real Core checks support exact counted revisions and drill predicates, source overlaps, and honest known/not-reported/unknown/unavailable fields. The user-facing aggregate-to-record transition is only visible as static buttons and unexecuted React handlers in the cited desktop evidence. The approved task requires that transition to be usable and focusable.

The 19 focused report tests, 21 API/service tests, 34 desktop unit tests, 197 portable/Core contract tests, two native admission tests, and authenticated Windows protected-store case pass. The desktop tests contain no mounted click, keyboard, focus, denied/error, or recovery interaction for CorpusCanvasWorkspace; pure helper and server-rendered markup checks cannot prove the production event path.

The portable schema and generated TypeScript/Core clients, v19 additive migration, frozen v18 recovery contract, populated predecessor fixtures, protected report source/rights witnesses, provenance/outbox, architecture classifier, storage documentation, and approved UI-reference identity are updated. No unrelated scope expansion or migration-authority change was found in the reviewed candidate.

verification_review.assessment: Canonical line-ending SHA-256 of the manifest and every cited raw log reproduces. The 67-file manifest inventory exactly matches git diff --name-only 77fe987e..22e184e5. The build report has source.commit=22e184e5 and source.dirty=false. Selected command IDs exist in verification-profiles.json. The raw report log has five model tests plus fourteen migration/repository tests, the Core log covers API/service tests, and the Windows log shows one authenticated DPAPI/SQLCipher test. The desktop log reports 34 passing Vitest cases; the changed CorpusCanvasWorkspace test source uses renderToStaticMarkup throughout and never mounts or dispatches an event.

findings.title: Aggregate-to-record Corpus Canvas interaction lacks qualifying renderer proof
findings.reproduction: At candidate 22e184e5, inspect apps/desktop/src/app/CorpusCanvasWorkspace.test.tsx: it imports renderToStaticMarkup and all CorpusCanvasWorkspace render assertions use server markup; the remaining checks call pure comparison/recovery helpers. Search that file and the candidate's tests for a mounted CorpusCanvasWorkspace, click or keyboard event, focus assertion, and denied/error/retry transition; none is present. Inspect the bound artifacts/tmp/CAP-04.S04.T03.desktop-exact-22e184e5.log: its 34 passing Vitest cases are those static/helper tests and surrounding workflow tests. The authenticated Core test at tests/rights/test_runtime_windows.py exercises /reports/drill directly, not the renderer. Thus the cited checks cannot establish approved S04 section 9.3 and task-start requirements that a user can activate an aggregate count, reach exact records, and recover focus/interaction after a denial or interruption.
findings.required_remediation: Preserve frozen R01 and this finding. Add a focused mounted-renderer or browser interaction regression using the production CorpusCanvasWorkspace: activate at least one source or coverage aggregate by keyboard/click, assert the transport receives the exact snapshot/filter, the matching record page is shown, and focus/announcement reaches the drill; exercise denied or interrupted inspection and the visible recovery control without retaining protected data. Bind its fresh exact-candidate result in an append-only R02 evidence submission, retaining the existing real Core/protected-store and reference checks. A later S04 performance benchmark or static markup test does not close this user interaction finding.

slice_obligations_not_disposed: Approved CAP-04.S04 section 11 incrementally precomputed project/source overlap summaries and required indexing remain unproven and must be resolved before S04 completion.

Representative warm/cold hardware/fixture/repetition/distribution performance evidence, full affected profiles, integrated accessibility/security/recovery, independent slice review, and W2 qualification remain later gates.
